title: Top 10 Business Marketing Apps for Small Businesses

facts.fact: The page is dated February 9, 2026 and is authored by Liz Hunt.

facts.quote: FDIC-Insured—Backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. Government

facts.fact: SmartBiz states that a small business can generally apply for an SBA loan twice, provided total funding stays within each program's borrowing limits.
facts.quote: Can you apply for an SBA loan twice? The answer is generally yes, as long as your total funding remains within each program’s borrowing limits.
